assumptions_and_limits: All outputs are sensitivity calculations, not an official corrected single-quarter EPS feed.

The inferred quarter average shares identity assumes cumulative weighted-average shares are measured on a common day-weighted basis, with comparable split/restatement bases. This accounting assumption was not verified for every issuer.
EPS-implied numerators are subtracted under the assumption of compatible EPS numerator definitions across periods.

The EPS lower/upper endpoints only propagate independently rounded reported EPS within +/- 0.005, while treating reported average shares as exact; they are conditional bounds, not statistical confidence intervals or unconditional true-EPS bounds.
If EPS was truncated rather than rounded to the nearest 0.01, or weighted-share conventions differ, those conditional bounds need revision.

Profit-based results subtract the rounded or truncated Profit field. Profit=0 need not mean exact zero profit; dividing its difference by inferred quarter shares cannot supply a trustworthy replacement near zero.
Zero gate changes describes point estimates only. E05 conditional YoY ranges from approximately 93.598 to 110.059 times and straddles the 100-times training exclusion threshold.
E10 year-base EPS sensitivity interval crosses zero; its year-growth ratio has no finite continuous conditional interval over that range.
A later issuer quarterly report can diagnose an earlier estimate but cannot be backfilled into a January 31 signal if first disclosed February 12.

The issuer-reported E05 single-quarter EPS numbers 13.39 and 0.12 are themselves rounded; comparing their displayed points with sensitivity bounds is not a proof of inconsistency. They must not be labeled as available January 31 without timing evidence.
